errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are not sorted by frequency. The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their values from left to right.

The description incorrectly identifies "验证集" (Validation Set) as the label for the y-axis. The y-axis has no label. "验证集" is the label for the data series, as shown in the legend at the bottom of the chart.

errors.text_span: “公司上市”“企业融资”“股东增持”等事件频次在70至90之间
errors.evidence: The description claims that the frequency for "股东增持" (Shareholder Increase) is between 70 and 90. However, the chart shows its value is approximately 62, which is outside of this range.
